title: Poppy Seed Coleslaw with Lemon and Honey
changes_from_base: A light, mayonnaise-free lemon and honey vinaigrette with toasted poppy seeds replaces the creamy dressing; only green cabbage is used.
summary: A light, mayonnaise-free slaw of finely shredded cabbage in a sweet-sharp lemon and honey vinaigrette with toasted poppy seeds.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt, for wilting (most is rinsed off)

steps.title: Wilt
steps.text: Toss the cabbage with the wilting salt in the colander and leave 45-60 min. Rinse, drain and dry well in a tea towel.

steps.title: Toast the seeds
steps.text: Toast the poppy seeds in the dry pan for 1-2 min until fragrant, then tip into the bowl.

steps.title: Dress
steps.text: Whisk in the shallot, lemon juice, oil, mustard, sugar and honey.

steps.title: Toss and chill
steps.text: Toss the cabbage in the dressing and chill 30 min.

tips: Shred the cabbage as finely as you can.
Toasting the poppy seeds brings out their nutty flavour.
Good with fish and fried foods.
storage: Keeps covered in the fridge for up to 2 days; stir before serving. Not suitable for freezing. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
